steps.description: Retrieve the latest version of the application source code from the version control repository.
Initiate an automated build and testing process based on the updated source code.
Package the application into a deployable artifact suitable for the target environment.
Store the built artifact in a centralized repository for versioned access and distribution.
Release the new application version to the target runtime environment and update the running service.
Verify the deployment by checking the application's health and performance metrics.
Update the deployment records and documentation to reflect the new version and changes.
Notify stakeholders about the successful deployment and provide release notes.
Collect performance and operational metrics from application components and infrastructure resources.
Aggregate and display collected metrics through dashboards for real-time visibility.
Define threshold-based conditions to detect abnormal system behavior.
Notify responsible teams when alert conditions are triggered.
Examine system logs and metrics to identify the root cause of detected issues.
Analyze the impact of issues on system performance and user experience.
Create and assign tasks to resolve the identified issues and implement fixes.
Review and update the monitoring and alerting configuration to prevent similar issues.
Conduct vulnerability scans and assessments on the application and infrastructure.
Analyze the scan results to identify potential security risks and threats.
Develop and implement remediation plans to address identified vulnerabilities.
Configure and deploy security controls, such as firewalls and access controls.
Monitor and audit system activity to detect and respond to security incidents.
Develop and maintain compliance documentation and reports.
Conduct regular security awareness training for development and operations teams.
Review and update security policies and procedures to ensure ongoing compliance.
Collect and analyze metrics on resource utilization, such as CPU, memory, and storage.
Identify underutilized or overprovisioned resources and develop optimization plans.
Implement autoscaling and load balancing to ensure efficient resource allocation.
Configure and deploy infrastructure as code to ensure consistency and reproducibility.
Monitor and analyze the impact of optimization efforts on system performance and costs.
Develop and implement strategies for reserved instance planning and cost optimization.
Create and manage resource utilization reports and dashboards for stakeholders.
Review and update infrastructure and resource utilization policies to ensure ongoing optimization.

title: Collaborate with Development Teams on CI/CD Pipelines

steps.description: Work with development teams to design and implement CI/CD pipelines.
Develop and maintain automated testing and validation scripts.
Configure and deploy code quality and security scanning tools.
Implement automated deployment and rollback processes.
Monitor and analyze pipeline performance and efficiency.
Develop and maintain pipeline documentation and knowledge base.
Collaborate with development teams to identify and prioritize pipeline improvements.
Review and update CI/CD pipeline policies and procedures to ensure ongoing improvement.
